records.title: 10-Q ALARM.COM HOLDINGS, INC. JUNE 30, 2023
records.text: •SaaS and license revenue increased 8% to $140.4 million during the three months ended June 30, 2023 from $129.5 million during the three months ended June 30, 2022.

records.title: 10-Q ALARM.COM HOLDINGS, INC. JUNE 30, 2023
records.text: SaaS and license revenue represented 63% and 64% of our revenue during the three and six months ended June 30, 2023, respectively, as compared to 61% and 60% in the same periods in the prior year.

records.title: 10-Q ALARM.COM HOLDINGS, INC. JUNE 30, 2023
records.text: Software license revenue represented 3% of our revenue during each of the three and six months ended June 30, 2023 and 2022.

records.title: 10-Q ALARM.COM HOLDINGS, INC. JUNE 30, 2023
records.text: The $7.1 million purchase price consideration allocated to developed technology was recorded as an intangible asset at the time of the asset acquisition and is being amortized on a straight-line basis over an estimated useful life of five years.

records.title: 10-Q ALARM.COM HOLDINGS, INC. JUNE 30, 2023
records.text: For the six months ended June 30, 2023, cash flows from operating activities were $33.3 million, compared to $12.3 million for the same period in the prior year.
